limbPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production raster atlas for an existing 2D cartoon rig, genuinely transparent background, no glow or cast shadow. References show approved Tavi (teal shirt/orange tie/charcoal trousers), Kuda (mustard pullover/navy trousers), Mira (plum blouse/charcoal trousers). Preserve their exact clothing colours and simple clean black contour drawing, no mechanical joints.
Create EXACTLY SIX isolated source cutouts, laid out in a strict three-column two-row atlas, equal cells with wide empty gutters. Columns Tavi, Kuda, Mira. Top row: ONE full continuous LONG SLEEVE for each character, shoulder to wrist, hanging straight vertically, no hand. Bottom row: ONE full continuous TROUSER LEG for each character, hip to ankle, straight vertically, no shoe. Make sleeves about 4 times longer than wide, trousers about 6 times longer than wide. Sleeve shoulder end smoothly rounded, wrist with a subtle real cuff; trouser top rounded, ankle straight. The midpoint of each piece is the elbow/knee, but NEVER draw any line, cut, break, plate, band, black cap or extra piece there: ONE unbroken fabric silhouette and fill from end to end. Very minimal flat shading matching the references. No skin, head, torso, tie or footwear, no text. Shapes must be fully inside their cells, upright, neither rotated nor bent. This atlas will be split mechanically; preserve true transparent alpha.
